name: I Have Yet to Become a Doll Today
overview: When the world turns into a game map, humans become dolls continuously. Ding! Welcome to the Dolls' Game! The rules of the game are as follows: 1. One will become a doll if he refuses to play the game! 2. One will become a doll if he loses the game! 3. One will be rewarded with a doll if he clears the game! Check how a smart scheming girl works with a strong handsome guy to clear the game vigorously!
